record_title: Exact forcing balance laws and a sign trichotomy for the Burke–Shaw flow
provenance: A theorem for the classical Burke–Shaw ordinary differential equation derived from exact quadratic balance identities and compared with prior analytical and mechanical studies of the system.
limitations: The full text of Panchev, Spassova and Vitanov (2007), whose abstract mentions temporal asymptotes for the Burke–Shaw system, was not inspected and remains the principal prior-coverage risk. The full text of Shukla et al. (2026) was also not inspected; its abstract overlaps the qualitative role of external torque but does not expose the exact global-convergence and invariant-average statements recorded here.
